title: Standard Integration Methods
subject: Mathematics (NDA/CDS)

blocks.heading: 1. Fundamental Indefinite Integrals
bullets: ∫ cos x dx = sin x + C
∫ sec² x dx = tan x + C

blocks.heading: 2. Logarithmic Trigonometric Integrals
bullets: ∫ tan x dx = ln|sec x| + C = -ln|cos x| + C
∫ cot x dx = ln|sin x| + C
∫ sec x dx = ln|sec x + tan x| + C
∫ cosec x dx = ln|cosec x - cot x| + C = ln|tan(x/2)| + C

blocks.heading: 4. Integration by Parts & Definite Properties
bullets: ∫ u·v dx = u ∫ v dx - ∫ [ u' ∫ v dx ] dx (Choose u based on ILATE priority).
King's Property : ∫[0 to a] f(x) dx = ∫[0 to a] f(a-x) dx
∫[a to b] f(x) dx = ∫[a to b] f(a+b-x) dx
∫[-a to a] f(x) dx = 2∫[0 to a] f(x) dx (if f(x) is even); = 0 (if f(x) is odd).
